label: For every fixed typed form/end profile, goodness exactly coextends with due actuality, or some…
paraphrase: For every fixed typed form/end profile, goodness exactly coextends with due actuality, or some goodness is surplus beyond due actuality, or some due actuality is omitted from goodness. Coverage uses excluded middle; surplus and omission may overlap. This is not a claim that named historical schools exhaust the definitions.
